decisions.reason: The check-in app was featured on the home page and fits the firm's announced innovation-led strategy, and its weak results can be blamed on the temporary COVID collapse in air travel, with contactless processing likely gaining relevance as traffic recovers.

PassBoard was publicly launched with a dated announcement and represents in-house technology investment central to the firm's high-end positioning, so management will persist and attribute disappointing uptake to the pandemic downturn.

The self-service check-in solution builds on the firm's airport offer and was visibly promoted, so with sunk development costs and aviation recovering, management sees the setback as temporary rather than a reason to withdraw.
